Project.title: Project
Project.description: Represents a construction site or project.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Project entity.

status.description: Status of the project (e.g., planned, in progress, completed).

userId.description: The ID of the user who owns this project.

Quote.title: Quote
Quote.description: Represents a quote for a project.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Quote entity.

subtotal.description: Subtotal amount of the quote (before tax).

total.description: Total amount of the quote (including tax).

status.description: Status of the quote (e.g., draft, sent, accepted).

validUntil.description: Date until which the quote is valid.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the quote was created.

userId.description: The ID of the user who owns this quote.

QuoteLine.title: Quote Line
QuoteLine.description: Represents a single line item within a quote.

description.description: Description of the work or item.

quantity.description: Quantity of the item or unit of work.

total.description: Total price for this line (quantity * unitPrice).

Invoice.title: Invoice
Invoice.description: Represents an invoice based on a quote.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Invoice entity.

amountRemaining.description: Remaining amount due on the invoice.

userId.description: The ID of the user who owns this invoice.
